Timer

Set hours, minutes and seconds — or tap a preset like the 25-minute Pomodoro — and get a countdown with a progress bar and a beep alarm when time is up.

00:05:00

Time’s up!

The alarm beep needs this tab open with your volume up. The countdown is timestamp-based, so it stays accurate even in a background tab.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter hours, minutes and seconds, or tap one of the preset chips.
  2. Click "Start" to begin the countdown.
  3. Use "Pause" to hold the countdown and "Start" again to resume.
  4. Listen for the beep alarm and watch the progress bar when time runs out.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Will the timer keep working in a background tab?

The countdown is timestamp-based, so it stays accurate even if the tab is in the background. The alarm sound needs the tab to be at least open; some browsers may silence audio in background tabs.

Can I change a preset before starting?

Yes — the presets (1m, 5m, 10m, 25m Pomodoro) simply fill the hours, minutes and seconds inputs for you, and you can adjust them before starting.

How does the alarm sound work?

The alarm plays a beep through your device's speakers using the Web Audio API. Keep your volume up and the tab open to hear it.
